Перед изменением сохраняются свежий исхо:
Before a change, the original fresh configuration backup, identity and SHA-256 are saved in ADBAccessBackups/<UUID>. adb-access-pending.json is separate from preliminary preparation. An unfinished installation or another operation blocks activation.

If the stock zwrt_bsp.usb.set method is advertised, mode=debug is sent. If method listing is unavailable, the historical fallback is permitted only for CN MU5250 through B27. Explicit absence of the method means it is skipped. Early firmware requires Skip firmware check; this does not bypass installer restrictions. Actual root USB ADB is checked for up to 90 seconds. A command with an uncertain response is not sent again.
Если штатный USB debug не помог, приложе:
If stock USB debug does not help, the app signs in to the same Web endpoint again and saves a new fresh backup. Restoration is permitted only for verified B31. Decryption, gzip, tar, the inner MD5 and archive contents are verified; only the ADB boot line in etc/rc.local changes. After upload, SHA-256 and identity are checked again. Restore intent is saved before the single request; the modem will reboot.

If the ADB line is already present in the verified fresh backup, no restore is repeated: the diagnostic button requests one stock reboot to apply the existing configuration. This has a separate saved intent. An already working ADB channel never triggers a reboot. The B31 restore method is not used on B02 or unknown firmware.
После восстановления или перезагрузки пр:
After restoration or reboot, the app waits up to four minutes for USB ADB and verifies root and identity. A Web response alone does not mean success. offline, unauthorized, missing permissions, local adb errors and modem mismatches are reported separately.

If the reply is lost or the modem is still booting, Resume ADB activation reads the saved journal and only repeats verification after an already requested restore or reboot. This resume needs neither Web nor its password. Uncertain commands are never automatically repeated. Completion evidence and backups remain local; the active journal is removed only after ADB is confirmed.

The application connection status remains tied to SSH. Previously connected SSH is checked again after the operation; a lost connection cannot remain green. ADB is available to diagnostics and firmware research. Automatic ADB activation is disabled while the terminal is open.

Как включается и выключается ADB: How ADB is enabled and disabled
ADB нужен для первоначальной настройки S: ADB is used for initial SSH setup. The switch enables or disables USB ADB through a verified SSH connection on a supported USB configuration. The app then verifies the same device and USB state. Opening this help does not run anything.
Сведения, исследование прошивки, диагнос: Device information, firmware research, diagnostics and management use SSH. ADB is used for initial SSH setup. Stock Web and the agent web panel open in your browser.
Перед переключением проверяются CID, заг: Before switching, the app verifies the CID, boot session, USB configuration and ADB state. Only the ADB function link in configfs changes; other USB functions and startup settings are preserved. USB networking may disconnect briefly. The app reconnects over SSH and confirms the result. Without confirmation, the script restores the original configuration. The change lasts until the modem reboots.
Если SSH ещё не настроен, доступен тольк: If SSH is not configured, only a supported stock Web ADB activation method is available. Fill in the initial setup settings. Older firmware uses the advertised stock USB debug method; verified B31 has a separate path through a verified configuration backup with a user-supplied key. A reboot may be needed. The backup and journal are retained; after restoration is requested, only result verification is repeated.
Неопределённое состояние показывается от: Unknown state is shown separately from disabled ADB. Switching is unavailable while a terminal, another operation, unfinished setup, IMEI write or restoration is active. Unsupported configurations show a reason; the app does not automatically select another management transport.
Нужны адрес модема, пароль штатного Web,:
Use the modem address, stock Web password, a separate agent password and a USB data cable. Check connections only checks available channels; Connect uses SSH. USB ADB is a step in initial SSH setup. ADB activation and installation use the separate preparation button. The app takes a local lock and checks for unfinished operations.

Over HTTP /ubus/, it requests zte_web_sault, hashes the password with SHA-256, then hashes that value with the challenge. The resulting hash is sent to web_login. An incorrect password stops preparation; no other passwords are tried automatically. The application reads the IMEI and both firmware versions, requests and downloads a fresh encrypted settings backup, and verifies identity again. The original, identity.json and SHA-256 are saved locally in SetupBackups/<UUID>. This is a settings backup, not a full flash image.

Checking working ADB or SSH does not require decrypting the backup. The backup-key suffix is used only for the B31 restore path. Passwords and the Web session are omitted from progress logs.
